titleEn: Count the Number of Consistent Strings
title: 统计一致字符串的数目
summary: 若一个单词所有字符都属于 allowed，则为一致字符串；统计 words 中一致字符串数量。
insight: 把 allowed 字符放入布尔表，逐词检查每个字符；遇到不允许字符立即判该词不一致。
pitfalls: 一个字符不允许就排除整个单词
统计单词数而非字符数

solutions.title: 允许字符布尔表
solutions.idea: 常数时间判断单词中的每个字符。
steps: 对每个 word 假设 consistent=true
扫描字符，未标记则 false 并停止；一致时 answer++

code.java: class Solution { public int countConsistentStrings(String allowed,String[] words){boolean[] valid=new boolean[26];for(char letter:allowed.toCharArray())valid[letter-'a']=true;int answer=0;for(String word:words){boolean consistent=true;for(char letter:word.toCharArray())if(!valid[letter-'a']){consistent=false;break;}if(consistent)answer++;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countConsistentStrings(allowed:String,words:Array<String>):Int{val valid=BooleanArray(26);for(letter in allowed)valid[letter-'a']=true;return words.count{word->word.all{valid[it-'a']}}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int countConsistentStrings(string allowed,vector<string>& words){array<bool,26> valid{};for(char letter:allowed)valid[letter-'a']=true;int answer=0;for(auto& word:words)answer+=all_of(word.begin(),word.end(),[&](char letter){return valid[letter-'a'];});return answer;} };
